info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Reconciliation Management API
info.description: The Account Reconciliation Management API facilitates the process of updating and finalizing account reconciliation records. This endpoint allows financial institutions and businesses to adjust reconciliation details efficiently, ensuring that all transactions are accurately reflected in their accounting systems. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts and accounting software developers who seek to automate and streamline their reconciliation workflows. By using this API, organizations can maintain precise financial records and enhance their reporting capabilities.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to patch the details of a specific account reconciliation identified by the unique code ACC-200045, making it easy to modify and update relevant information as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update account reconciliation details for a specified account. Ensure that the request adheres to the defined schema to avoid validation errors.

200.description: The account reconciliation update was successful.
